scope: Unreleased guidance experiment over unchanged v0.0.21 runtime; not a new product admission.
rule: Choose one route. Run its read_command to read and verify that selected file, then its required_additional_reads and named checks. Report requested identities exactly and stop. For an unmatched task follow the relevant general route or public Skill.

license-policy.intent: may I use the v0.0.21 product for research or commercial purposes

release-orientation.intent: identify the published release version/tag, public Agent entrypoint or compiler byte identity before compilation

release-lib-route-readiness.intent: does this v0.0.21 product set bind every included Lib package and API route, and where is its lifecycle stage decided

position-aware-capability-negative.intent: decide type or feature support by source, public-value, async and Host position, including u64 and Map

producer-release-u64-delta.intent: compare historical producer implementation versus product release status of u64, u32 and char

ordinary-source-positive.intent: compile and run the canonical s32/bool tuple example

release-state-separation.intent: direct WAsmC source use of wasmc-system-telemetry@0.0.1 sampler resource

dynamic-client-gateway.intent: is the dynamic Client/Gateway available in this product and is it a formal Lib

library-first-selection.intent: select and verify the released Base64 capability

host-authority-boundary.intent: determine permissions for generated Host imports: application allowlist, requests versus grants, no ambient access

source-adaptation.intent: write or change a new pure ordinary-source program and execute requested calls

library-discovery.intent: find an unfamiliar reusable capability; inspect exact package/API and verify behavior
